verdict.rationale: BugSnag documents a first-party webhook plugin that sends error and project data as soon as BugSnag receives and processes it. That is a genuine outbound HTTP callback a programmatic consumer can receive, not just the chat-app alerts (Slack, Teams, PagerDuty), which don't count here. The evidence is a single thin doc line, so missing for 10: documentation of which event types can be subscribed to, payload schema, delivery/retry or signing guarantees, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
